```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)

# Set default chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "80%"
)

# Set ggplot theme
theme_set(theme_minimal())
```

```{r}
# API Key - Normally wouldn't share this but specified in the instructions
api_key <- "486191162bba8179c3f286918db61916"
url <- "https://api.stlouisfed.org"
url_ext <- "fred/series/observations"
series <- c('DJIA', 'DGS10', 'UNRATE')

```

```{r}
# Get data from the FRED API for each series
all_data <- series |> 
  map(~ {
  response <- request("https://api.stlouisfed.org") |>
    req_url_path_append(url_ext) |>
    req_url_query(
      api_key = api_key,
      series_id = "DJIA",
      file_type = "json",
      observation_start = '2000-01-01', # YYYY-MM-DD formatted string
      observation_end = '2024-12-31',
      frequency = 'm'
    ) |>
    req_perform() |> 
    resp_body_json()
  }) |> 
  set_names(series)
```

```{r}
# Extract the data to tibbles 
extract_fred_data <- function(response) {
  response$observations |>
    map_dfr(~ tibble(
      date = as.Date(.x$date),
      value = if(.x$value == ".") NA_real_ else as.numeric(.x$value)
    )) |>
    filter(!is.na(value))
}

# Define datasets
djia_data <- all_data$DJIA |> extract_fred_data()
dgs10_data <- all_data$DGS10 |> extract_fred_data()
unrate_data <- all_data$UNRATE |> extract_fred_data()

# Append and melt
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  djia_data |> mutate(series_id = "Dow Jones Industrial Average"),
  dgs10_data |> mutate(series_id = "10 Year Treasury Yields"), 
  unrate_data |> mutate(series_id = "Unemployment Rate")
) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = value,
    values_to = "observation"
  ) |> 
  select(-name)
  
```

```{r}
# Plot the time series
plot(combined_data$date, combined_data$observation)
```
